instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a bright hallway near a doorway, the man in the brown cardigan (R1) crouches on the left, holding a grey backpack. The boy in the school uniform (R2), dressed in a white collared shirt, black tie, and black trousers, stands on the right. The boy looks down as he slips his arm into the backpack strap held by the man. Cool, natural daylight enters from the side, casting soft shadows on the neutral-toned wall behind them.
